Given that the anabolic effect of a protein-rich meal lasts 5 to 6 hours (75), it seems prudent that people seeking to maximize hypertrophy should aim for a protein intake of 0.4 to 0.55 g/kg/meal spread across at least four meals to consume 1.6 to 2.2 g/kg/day (126). Increasing protein distribution across more than four daily meals is an option for those who prefer more frequent feedings, but no additional benefits appear to be derived from the approach (83).
